title: Kashi
tagline: Payments Infra layer which supports subscription model and allows you to take a fee cut
description: Its a smart contract which allows businesses to register themselves and their subscription models. Users can then register for subscriptions of these businesses onchain. We will also provide a Frontend for users to manage their subscriptions and a Frontend for businesses to register, manage tiers and withdraw amount.
how_its_made: Made using Solidity and React based Frontend. In future we will add email based notifications for users. We also plan to integrate world ID and attestations. We did not have a lot of time to create it end to end including the Backend infra for emails at the moment. Just adding more details
